title: 英文名词复数（pluralize.py）
scope: Owns only pluralize.py and tests/test_pluralize.py: the pluralize function with its pinned rule order plus tests. Does not own ellipse.py, issn.py, any existing file, or team/** paths.
task:
Create pluralize.py (new file only; do not modify any existing file) implementing pluralize(word) -> str. Standard library only; do not import ellipse or issn.

Validation: word not a str raises TypeError; empty string, or any character outside lowercase a-z, raises ValueError.

Rules are applied in this pinned order, first match wins (order is part of the spec):
1. Uncountable set {sheep, fish, deer, species, series, aircraft}: return the word unchanged.
2. Irregular table: child->children, person->people, man->men, woman->women, mouse->mice, goose->geese, tooth->teeth, foot->feet, ox->oxen, die->dice, quiz->quizzes.
3. f/fe -> ves list {leaf, life, knife, wife, wolf, loaf, thief, shelf, half, calf}: ending in fe -> drop fe and add ves; ending only in f -> drop f and add ves.
4. o -> es list {hero, potato, tomato, echo, torpedo, veto}: add es.
5. Ends in consonant + y (the character before y is not a/e/i/o/u): drop y and add ies; vowel + y does not take this rule.
6. Ends in s, x, z, ch, sh: add es.
7. Otherwise: add s.

Write tests/test_pluralize.py with a case for EVERY acceptance item below:
- pluralize("cat") == "cats"; pluralize("dog") == "dogs"
- pluralize("city") == "cities"; pluralize("baby") == "babies"
- pluralize("day") == "days"; pluralize("boy") == "boys"
- pluralize("box") == "boxes"; pluralize("class") == "classes"
- pluralize("watch") == "watches"; pluralize("wish") == "wishes"
- pluralize("child") == "children"; pluralize("person") == "people"; pluralize("mouse") == "mice"
- pluralize("sheep") == "sheep"; pluralize("fish") == "fish"
- pluralize("leaf") == "leaves"; pluralize("knife") == "knives"; pluralize("life") == "lives"; pluralize("wolf") == "wolves"; pluralize("roof") == "roofs"
- pluralize("hero") == "heroes"; pluralize("potato") == "potatoes"; pluralize("photo") == "photos"; pluralize("piano") == "pianos"; pluralize("echo") == "echoes"
- pluralize("quiz") == "quizzes"; pluralize("church") == "churches"; pluralize("bus") == "buses"
- pluralize("toy") == "toys"; pluralize("key") == "keys"
- pluralize("") raises ValueError; pluralize("Cat") raises ValueError; pluralize("cat!") raises ValueError
- pluralize(None) raises TypeError; pluralize(3) raises TypeError

Checks (verbatim): python3 -m pytest tests/test_pluralize.py -q ; python3 -m pytest tests/ -q
